projects.title: Published Children's Book
projects.blurb: A children's book my daughter Sara and I created together. I wrote the story, based on one of many I used to make up while tucking the kids in at night. Sara illustrated and published it — she's the one who gets paid for any sale.

projects.title: AI Zoltar Speaks Animatronic
projects.blurb: A desktop animatronic Zoltar, built from scratch and inspired by the 1988 movie Big. Powered by three different AI models to understand a wish, formulate a response, and — unlike the movie version — speak it out loud! He'll warn you of the dangers of your wish, but will he grant it?

projects.title: The Poeteer, a poetry camera
projects.blurb: An AI poetry camera that captions what it sees and writes a poem about it, then prints the poem out a slot in the back. Built in a box-camera format mixing old and new tech: a laser-cut, engraved wooden box with 18 different 3D-modeled and printed parts. My daughter Sara made it beautiful with the engraving and medallion design. Built on instructions and code generously shared by the original creators of the poetry camera.

projects.title: ELOS Aliens Beyond, Sci-Fi Book Self-Published
projects.blurb: This is a book that my father-in-law, Ed, wrote back in the early 80s. The manuscript has been stored away until 2023. His daughters, Teena and Tierra, along with me, did the editing. My daughter, Sara, did the illustrations and formatting in preparation to publish. After nearly 40 years, It's now available as a paperback or ebook.

projects.title: The Spectral Hotline
projects.blurb: Bridging the gap between reality and imagination, the Spectral Hotline allows the caller to dial characters of my imagination, including those who have anxiously awaited someone to answer their call from beyond. [Queue an evil laugh].

projects.title: Memory Spark Station
projects.blurb: I built this machine to conjure up old and hopefully fond memories.  Positioned as an audio trivia game, like an old-school "Name That Tune," this machine can be loaded with popular audio clips (e.g., music, Historical speeches, Iconic movie one-liners and villains, kids' shows, famous duos, etc.). Users choose the track (e.g., 70s-80s music) and guess at the artist and title. In the process, fond memories pop into the minds of past concerts, crazy times with friends or family, etc. I upgraded the track selection from a knob to a touch screen mimicking a companion mobile app I built for taking the game on the go. The new touch screen also features a "Hint" and a "Reveal" button to round out the experience.

projects.title: Custom Animated Nosferatu Animatronic
projects.blurb: One of my favorite horror characters, this Home Depot Nosferatu animatronic was given a new control box so I could make him move when and say whatever I want. This video shows a custom greeting programmed for an Orlando CityArts gallery event. It was part of the CityArts annual Monsters exhibit in October, and with luck, Nosferatu will welcome guests next year.

projects.title: Haunted mirror
projects.blurb: Halloween has taken on a new role since retirement — we now host an annual party that's become a neighborhood favorite, and this is one of the many props built for it. This mirror quietly awaits an unsuspecting guest to linger in front, admiring their extravagant costume, grabbing the attention of the Grim Reaper, reminding them of what's to come.

projects.title: Haunted Portrait
projects.blurb: I always loved the Haunted Mansion's portraits that came to life. I created one with an old digital frame and a motion sensor to bring the portrait to life. This is a digital painting of me that my daughter had done some years ago. I thought it would be fun to bring me to life, delivering a warning and a clue to how to escape the haunted house they dared to enter.

projects.title: Gallery Wall Digital Frame
projects.blurb: The Gallery Wall project was inspired by the macOS Sliding Tiles screensaver. I found that it is a great way to show several images in an interesting way. I have a big-screen TV in my studio that I wanted to contribute to the studio's artistic theme. I built a similar sliding tiles application that runs on the Raspberry Pi, can load images locally or from iCloud, and displays images in three different configurations. It can display in a sliding-tile-like collage, a 3-frame, and a full-screen image format. A WebUI allows the user to schedule when to turn on and off the image display, manage the Wifi network and image files, screen display format and synchronize with an iCloud album.

projects.title: Floor Projector for Motorcycle
projects.blurb: An aftermarket car door projector, repurposed for a motorcycle. I swapped its light sensor for a motion detector, so at night, whenever motion is detected behind a parked bike, it projects an illuminated image onto the ground. The theme of this bike is Tinkerbell.

projects.title: Pepper's Ghost lantern
projects.blurb: Inspired by the Haunted Mansion's spinning Victorian dancers and paying homage to Madam Leota. This prop recreates the Pepper's Ghost illusion inside a decorative lantern, reflecting an AI-generated Ghost Host introduction to the chanting Madam Leota.

projects.title: Ghost Host doorbell
projects.blurb: My first prop dabbling with AI video. An AI-animated image of Nosferatu paired with the voice of the Haunted Mansion's Ghost Host — pairing a face that was never heard (Nosferatu debuted in a 1929 silent film) with a voice of a character that was never seen. Triggered by a push button decorated to look and sound like a haunted doorbell.

projects.title: Eyes Behind the Mask
projects.blurb: A mask my father, Henry Schubert, created in 2006. I built the shadow box display and added a motion sensor and electronic eyes — walk near it and the eyes bring the mask to life. I liked these so much I used these eyes on The Poeteer and Zoltar.

projects.title: The Great and Powerful Oz Magic Fireplace
projects.blurb: Turns our fireplace into a haunted one. A 42-inch TV displays a demon-possessed fire, and you can summon the great and powerful Oz from The Wizard of Oz. I mashed audio snippets from the movie with an image of Oz using HeyGen AI to animate it. A button allows the guest to hear commands made to Dorothy, Toto, and her merry band of misfits.
